purpose: Machine-readable closure record for the completed compiler-architecture review goals: remove codegen AST body fallback, establish a minimal syntax-free CheckedProgram, cut over to a bounded real module graph, and retire persistent MIR compatibility projections.

policy.not_scope: production readiness, kernel productization, package registry, LSP product work
policy.completion_rule: A goal may move to complete only when the evidence anchors prove the requested end state, not merely when tests pass.

goals.requested_end_state: FunctionArtifact/body fallback is no longer an AST body ingress for codegen; codegen is driven by VerifiedProgram/MIR typed facts.

progress.strict_c: canonical executable MIR only; no function-body fallback ingress or legacy emitter remains
progress.strict_llvm: canonical executable MIR only; no function-body fallback ingress or legacy emitter remains
progress.broad_c: all previously reachable fallback cases are canonical or fail closed as explicitly unsupported
progress.broad_llvm: all previously reachable fallback cases are canonical or fail closed as explicitly unsupported
progress.completion_note: The AST fallback request payload, specialized plans, census scaffolding, stale fallback-named test wrappers, and both legacy body emitters are deleted.

completion_evidence.needle: fn emitVerifiedMirFunction(self: *CEmitter, fact: mir.CallableEmissionFact, fn_mir: mir.Function, render_attrs: anytype) !bool
fn emitExecutableMirFunction(self: *LlvmEmitter, fact: mir.CallableEmissionFact, fn_mir: mir.Function, render_attrs: codegen_attrs.FunctionRenderAttrs) !bool

goals.requested_end_state: A minimal syntax-free CheckedProgram owns callable/signature/effect identity and feeds typed MIR/VerifiedProgram; MC does not add a second expression IR or a full Typed HIR.

The loader no longer compiles through textual inclusion/combined source; semantic identity is per-file/per-module, without adding incremental databases, serialized caches, or separate compilation to this goal.

Persistent MIR AST payloads and typed-vs-legacy identity mirrors are removed. This goal does not claim removal of structural ValueType-plus-TypeId validation pairs, presentation spelling tables, or source/string-only legacy facts that have no typed mirror.
